files.modifications: Adapted affine scaling formula, global and stepwise stats selection, per-embodiment dispatch, constant-field handling, and clipping. Replaced framework utilities with standalone Python and Torch operations; new public API names.

New implementation of data assembly contract: metadata field order, padding masks, normalization, and padded delta action semantics. No base processor or framework dependency. Relative joint reference uses first observation; output action decoder retains all horizon steps.
New implementation preserving camera order, RoboTwin 288x256/384x320 mosaics, aspect-preserving resize and crop, CTHW output, and [-1, 1] normalization.

Independent local read-only LeRobot v2 reader; source reviewed for time offsets, endpoint windows, split/filter and statistics behavior. Does not copy vendored LeRobot code. Raises on corrupt samples instead of silently replacing them; supports embedded images and PyAV videos; v3 is explicitly unsupported.

Reimplemented augmentation API as ClipAugment; preserves one sample-level probability draw, independent camera draws, temporally shared color/gamma/exposure/crop/rotation/noise, operation order, and recipe parameter names.

files.modifications: Consolidated data appearance stages into a new AppearanceRandomizer API with metadata-only configuration state. Preserves canonical C2R-DR4 p=0.8 photometric->AdaIN->Fourier operation order, parameters, random draws and temporal consistency. Accepts camera lists or CHW/TCHW/camera-TCHW tensors. Validates unknown parameters and explicitly rejects enabled background replacement; no mask assets, SAM, background bank, geometric augmentation, or runtime framework was copied.

limitations: LeRobot v3 merged file layouts are not implemented.
Evaluation parity must be validated against a representative existing dataset and checkpoint before replacing a historical pipeline.
Heterogeneous field remapping is not enabled by this initial pipeline.
Dataset fingerprint covers metadata content, statistics, selection and parquet byte size/mtime; it does not hash complete video or parquet contents.
AppearanceRandomizer does not support mask-guided background replacement; requesting enabled background replacement raises NotImplementedError.
